templateVersions.content:
You are creating a credit review briefing for an internal approver.
Primary Record Id: {!$RecordSnapshot:AccountRecord.snapshot}
Task: Generate a concise but decision-ready summary of the Account and related records relevant for a credit card approval decision.
Requirements: - Focus only on business-relevant facts for credit approval. - Use factual tone, no speculation. - If a field is missing, say "Not available". - Do not invent values. - Keep response under 220 words. - End with a one-line recommendation: "Recommended Status: Approve" or "Recommended Status: Review".
Output format (exact section order): 1) Account Snapshot - Account Name - Account Number - Credit Tier - Credit Card Status - Annual Revenue - Phone
2) Related Signals - Top related Contact(s) and role if available - Open Cases count/severity if available - Recent Opportunity/Activity indicators if available
3) Risk Notes - 2-4 bullets on positive/negative risk indicators from available data
4) Recommendation - One sentence with Recommended Status and brief reason

templateVersions.content:
You are creating a credit review briefing for an internal approver.
Primary Record Id: {!$RecordSnapshot:AccountRecord.snapshot}
Task: Generate a concise but decision-ready summary of the Account and related records relevant for a credit card approval decision.
Requirements: - Focus only on business-relevant facts for credit approval. - Use factual tone, no speculation. - If a field is missing, say "Not available". - Do not invent values. - Suggest a credit limit only when Annual Revenue is available. - Credit limit rule: Suggested Credit Limit = floor(Annual Revenue / $100,000) * $10,000. - Examples: $100,000 Annual Revenue = $10,000 limit; $200,000 Annual Revenue = $20,000 limit; $350,000 Annual Revenue = $30,000 limit; $1,000,000 Annual Revenue = $100,000 limit. - If Annual Revenue is below $100,000 or missing, say "Suggested Credit Limit: Not available". - Keep response under 220 words. - End with a one-line recommendation: "Recommended Status: Approve" or "Recommended Status: Review".
Output format (exact section order): 1) Account Snapshot - Account Name - Account Number - Credit Tier - Credit Card Status - Annual Revenue - Suggested Credit Limit - Phone
2) Related Signals - Top related Contact(s) and role if available - Open Cases count/severity if available - Recent Opportunity/Activity indicators if available
3) Risk Notes - 2-4 bullets on positive/negative risk indicators from available data
4) Recommendation - One sentence with Recommended Status, Suggested Credit Limit, and brief reason based on Annual Revenue and available risk signals
